attempts.summary: Used Ansible from node2 (the only node with ansible installed) as the control node to hold curl at its current pinned version on node1, via an idempotent dpkg_selections playbook. Verified functionally with a real system upgrade: curl stayed at 8.5.0-2ubuntu10.8 even though a newer version (8.5.0-2ubuntu10.15) was available and other packages upgraded. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on both node1 and node2, proving boot-id changes and post-restart recovery of the hold and Ansible control connectivity.
